xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4255: Change effort live on claude-code sessions and replace 'Effort unverified' with the effective effort and its source

plan.title: Change effort live on claude-code sessions and replace 'Effort unverified' with the effective effort and its source
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: This is already slice S3 of an eight-way decomposition of PAN-4249. The 34 files are one vertical feature: two server doors that share one live-change core, the transcript reader that confirms and observes effort, and the composer chip that calls the doors and shows the result. 14 of the files are tests, 3 are docs. Splitting further would ship a chip with no door or a door no UI calls.

narratives.Problem: claude-code conversations cannot change effort from the dashboard: POST /api/conversations/:name/thinking-level returns 400 for claude-code, the composer picker is disabled with 'Change effort in the native terminal', and the chip reads 'Effort unverified' for almost every claude-code session. Work agents have no live-change API.
narratives.Proposal: Deliver '/effort <level>' to the running claude-code pane through the existing verified delivery door (idle check, ensure-main input target, deliverAgentMessage), confirm via Claude Code's 'Set effort level to <level>' transcript record, and only then persist (conversation row, or AgentState effort+effortSource 'explicit'). Add POST /api/agents/:id/effort. Carry the observed effort (assistant 'effort' field or the confirmation record) as ContextUsage.lastEffort and on the agent conversation response. Replace 'Effort unverified' with a '<Level> · <source>' chip computed by a pure resolver, wired through a new useComposerEffort hook. See .pan/drafts/PAN-4255.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No /effort auto or /effort ultracode; only the five canonical levels.
- No writes to ~/.claude/settings.json and no attempt to stop Claude Code saving its per-model default.
- No live-change door for codex, ACP, OpenCode, kimi-code, muse, or pi agents; existing conversation branches for those harnesses are unchanged.
- No effort display on the Agents page, issue view, Command Deck rows, pan status/show, cost ledger, or sessions.json (PAN-4259).
- No effort_source column on conversations and no write-back of a native-terminal /effort change into stored effort.
- No CLI verb for live effort change.
- No edits to src/lib/agents/delivery.ts, src/dashboard/server/routes/conversations.ts, or src/dashboard/server/routes/command-deck.ts.
- No CLIProxy/GPT-via-claude-code effort handling (PAN-4260).
- No xhigh or max default anywhere; no new `?? 'high'` fallback or effort enum copy.

autoDecisions.summary: Confirmation = Claude Code's '<local-command-stdout>Set effort level to <level>' transcript record after the delivery offset; 10 s timeout persists nothing.
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified empirically on Claude Code 2.1.284: the record appears immediately without a turn, and rejections print 'Invalid argument:'. It is an observed fact, matching the issue's 'verified means observed'.

autoDecisions.summary: Refuse a live change with 409 busy only when the session is not idle within 5 s and the runtime mirror affirmatively reports it active; unknown state proceeds. Refuse with 409 permission-pending when the pane shows a permission prompt.
autoDecisions.rationale: Claude Code queues typed input mid-turn, so a queued /effort could apply after the confirmation window; but a never-used conversation may have no mirror state, and refusing on unknown would block every first change. The pane permission guard mirrors PAN-4278.

autoDecisions.summary: Do not restore ~/.claude/settings.json after /effort; document the per-model default side effect instead.
autoDecisions.rationale: Restoring races Claude Code's own write and could make the running session reload settings and undo the change; Overdeck sessions always launch with --effort so they are unaffected.

autoDecisions.summary: Observed effort travels as ContextUsage.lastEffort (beside lastModel) for conversations and as observedEffort/effortResolution on the agent conversation response for agents.
autoDecisions.rationale: Reuses existing HTTP/WS transport; command-deck.ts (1329/1331 lines) and routes/conversations.ts (1072/1072) cannot grow.

autoDecisions.summary: Chip shows '<Level> · <source>' with source words set/item/plan/tier/sub-role/role/project/default/terminal; observed is a separate tooltip/data attribute.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for effective effort and its source and bans guessed verification; 'terminal' flags a native /effort change that differs from the stored level.

autoDecisions.summary: No effort_source column on conversations: a stored effort reads as 'set'; a null effort resolves through the existing GET /api/effort/default.
autoDecisions.rationale: Smallest change consistent with S2's storage; no schema migration for a display detail.

autoDecisions.summary: The agent door supports claude-code agents only; other harnesses answer 400.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue scopes S3 to claude-code; conversation branches for other harnesses already exist and stay unchanged.

autoDecisions.summary: Clean the lint-effort baseline row tagged PAN-4255 by deriving ThinkingLevel from EffortLevel.
autoDecisions.rationale: The PAN-4249 brief tells siblings to lower the baseline for files they own; the row names this issue.

items.title: Add the pure /effort transcript parser leaf module

narrative.Action: PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-4255.md W1. Create src/lib/claude-effort-transcript.ts exporting parseEffortCommandStdout(content) -> {kind:'set',level}|{kind:'rejected',message}|null and observedEffortFromRecord(record) -> EffortLevel|null, pure, importing only @overdeck/contracts. Use the exact regexes and record rules in W1 (assistant: effort then perTurnEffort; user string content with a 'Set effort level to' stdout; isSidechain:true -> null). Table-test with the literal low/max/Invalid argument strings from the PRD's Empirical facts section.

items.title: Given the literal stdout '<local-command-stdout>Set effort level to low (saved as your default for new sessions): …', parseEffortCommandStdout returns { kind: 'set', level: 'low' }, and the max '(this session only)' string returns level 'max'.

Given the literal '<local-command-stdout>Invalid argument: bogus. Valid options are: …' string, parseEffortCommandStdout returns kind 'rejected' with the 'Invalid argument: bogus…' message; the '<command-name>/effort</command-name>' record content returns null.

observedEffortFromRecord returns 'low' for { type: 'assistant', effort: 'low' }, 'xhigh' for an assistant record with only perTurnEffort 'xhigh', and null for a record with isSidechain: true or effort 'auto'; `npx vitest run src/lib/__tests__/claude-effort-transcript.test.ts` exits 0.
Add applyClaudeLiveEffort: deliver /effort and wait for the transcript confirmation

narrative.Action: PRD W2. Create src/lib/agents/effort-live.ts with ClaudeLiveEffortTarget, ClaudeLiveEffortResult, injectable deps (waitForIdle, runtimeState, readPane, ensureMain, snapshot, deliver, readSince), the timing constants (5000/10000/250 ms), and applyClaudeLiveEffort(target, level, deps). Steps in order: (1) waitForAgentIdle; refuse 'busy' only when not idle AND getAgentRuntimeStateSync(paneId)?.state === 'active' (unknown state proceeds); (1a) read the pane via resolveAgentPaneIo(paneId).read(PANE_CAPTURE_LINES) and refuse 'permission-pending' when parsePermissionPrompt finds a prompt (PAN-4278), before ensure-main; (2) ensureMainInputTarget; (3) captureTranscriptUserRecordSnapshot offset; (4) deliverAgentMessage(paneId, `/effort ${level}`, caller, deliveryMethod); (5) poll the session file from the offset with fs/promises for the first <local-command-stdout> effort result (set -> ok, rejected -> effort-rejected); (6) timeout -> not-confirmed. Missing file = no records yet. Do not edit src/lib/agents/delivery.ts. Tests use vi.useFakeTimers and vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync.

items.title: Given readSince yields the low confirmation record on the second poll, applyClaudeLiveEffort returns { ok: true, effort: 'low' } and deliver was called exactly once with (paneId, '/effort low', caller, deliveryMethod).
Given no confirmation record within 10000 ms of fake time, it returns code 'not-confirmed'; given an 'Invalid argument' record, it returns code 'effort-rejected'.

Given waitForIdle resolves false and runtimeState returns { state: 'active' }, it returns code 'busy' and deliver is never called; given runtimeState returns null instead, delivery proceeds and deliver is called once.

Given readPane returns a screen that parsePermissionPrompt recognizes, it returns code 'permission-pending' and neither ensureMain nor deliver is called; given ensureMain returns ok:false it returns 'input-target-not-main' without delivering; given deliver returns ok:false it returns 'not-delivered' and the transcript is never read.
`npx vitest run src/lib/agents/__tests__/effort-live.test.ts` exits 0 and `rg -n "execSync" src/lib/agents/effort-live.ts` prints nothing.
Accept claude-code in POST /api/conversations/:name/thinking-level and persist only after confirmation

narrative.Action: PRD W3. In handleConversationThinkingLevel add an optional deps param (applyLiveEffort, persistEffort) and route harness 'claude-code' to a private handleClaudeConversationEffort before the existing harness guard: ended -> 422; invalid level -> 400; no claudeSessionId -> 422; clamp with resolveEffort({explicit, model, harness:'claude-code'}); call applyClaudeLiveEffort with paneId conv.tmuxSession, workspace conv.cwd, sessionId conv.claudeSessionId, deliveryMethod resolveConversationDeliveryMethod(conv); ok -> setConversationEffort(name, confirmed) and 200 {ok, effort, source:'explicit', warning?}; failures -> D13 status with {error, code}, never persisting. Leave codex/ACP/pi branches and src/dashboard/server/routes/conversations.ts unchanged.

items.title: Given a live claude-code conversation and applyLiveEffort resolving { ok: true, effort: 'low' }, a POST body { level: 'low' } returns 200 { ok: true, effort: 'low', source: 'explicit' }, applyLiveEffort received paneId equal to conv.tmuxSession, and persistEffort was called with (name, 'low').
Given applyLiveEffort resolves code 'not-confirmed', the handler returns 504 and persistEffort is never called; 'effort-rejected' returns 422 and 'busy' returns 409, also without persisting.

Given applyLiveEffort resolves code 'permission-pending', the handler returns 409 with code 'permission-pending' and persistEffort is never called; a body { level: 'bogus' } returns 400 without calling applyLiveEffort.
`npx vitest run src/lib/overdeck/__tests__/conversation-live-effort.test.ts` exits 0 and `git diff --stat origin/main -- src/dashboard/server/routes/conversations.ts` prints nothing.
Add POST /api/agents/:id/effort that persists effort to agent state after confirmation

narrative.Action: PRD W4. Create handleAgentLiveEffort(rawId, body, deps) in src/lib/agents/agent-live-effort.ts (getAgentState from ./agent-state-read.js; normalizeAgentId from ./identity.js): unknown -> 404; non-claude-code harness -> 400; invalid level -> 400; isAlive verdict not alive -> 422; no workspace/sessionId (getLatestSessionId) -> 422; clamp with resolveEffort; deliveryMethod by the supervisor rule from messaging.ts:784-786; applyClaudeLiveEffort with paneId = agent id, caller 'agent-effort'; ok -> saveAgentStateSync({...fresh state, effort, effortSource:'explicit'}) and 200; failures -> D13 codes without writing state. Add src/dashboard/server/routes/agents/effort.ts (pattern of postAgentPokeRoute, with validateAgentMessageOrigin), register postAgentEffortRoute in the agentsRouteLayer barrel, and add the no-loss-matrix row from the PRD.

items.title: Given a live claude-code agent and applyLiveEffort resolving { ok: true, effort: 'medium' }, the handler returns 200 and saveAgentState is called once with effort 'medium' and effortSource 'explicit'.
Given applyLiveEffort resolves code 'not-confirmed', the handler returns 504 and saveAgentState is never called.
Given a codex agent the handler returns 400 without calling applyLiveEffort; an unknown id returns 404; a dead session returns 422.

`rg -n "'/api/agents/:id/effort'" src/dashboard/server/routes/agents/effort.ts tests/unit/lib/overdeck/no-loss-matrix.ts` prints a match in both files and `npx vitest run tests/unit/lib/overdeck/no-loss-matrix.test.ts` exits 0.
Carry observed effort in ContextUsage.lastEffort from the transcript parsers

narrative.Action: PRD W5. Add lastEffort (optional NullOr String) to ContextUsage in packages/contracts/src/rpc.ts after lastModel. Add observedEffort: EffortLevel | null to ParseResult and the incremental parser state in types.ts. In parser.ts track observedEffort from observedEffortFromRecord(entry) on every entry, carried from priorState, NOT reset at the compact boundary, returned and carried in state, null in the initial results. In context-usage.ts pass observedEffort into buildContextUsage as lastEffort, from result.observedEffort in contextUsageFromParseResult and from a running observedEffortFromRecord value in readLatestAssistantUsage (checked before the assistant filter).

items.title: Given a transcript with an assistant record effort 'high' followed by the low /effort confirmation record, contextUsageFromParseResult(parsed, model).lastEffort equals 'low' and computeContextUsage(file, model) resolves lastEffort 'low'.
Given a transcript with no effort fields, both readers return lastEffort null; given a compact boundary after an effort 'low' turn, the incremental parser still reports observedEffort 'low'.

`npx vitest run src/dashboard/server/services/conversation/__tests__/observed-effort.test.ts src/dashboard/server/services/__tests__/conversation-service.test.ts` exits 0 and `npm run typecheck` exits 0.

Wire the composer chip and live change for claude-code conversations and agents through a useComposerEffort hook

narrative.Action: PRD W8. Map lastEffort in contextWindow.ts. Add observedEffort/effortResolution to MessagesResponse in ConversationPanel.tsx and pass observedEffort={contextWindowUsage?.lastEffort ?? data?.observedEffort ?? null} and effortResolution={data?.effortResolution ?? null} to ComposerFooter (max +6 lines; cap 1531). Create useComposerEffort that owns every effort concern now in ComposerFooter (resolveComposerEffort moves unchanged; effortVerified is deleted): liveChangeEnabled rule, resolution (agent prop / conversation.effort as explicit / fetchEffortDefault via useQuery / local override after a successful pick), chip via resolveEffortChip, pending state, POST to /api/agents/:id/effort when agentId else /api/conversations/:name/thinking-level, error restore + toast.error. items.title: Given a live claude-code conversation with effort 'high' and observedEffort 'high', the hook returns chip { level: 'high', source: 'explicit', observed: true } and liveChangeEnabled true.

When onChange('low') runs for that conversation, fetch receives POST /api/conversations/<name>/thinking-level with body { level: 'low' }, and after a 200 { effort: 'low' } response the chip renders 'Low · set'; with agentId 'agent-pan-1' the POST goes to /api/agents/agent-pan-1/effort.
